Method
e 1-Develop a broad understanding of
market trends based on research

e 3 - Discuss design options with aim of
narrowing down on the design that best
Suits the market and the project vision
Real Reaction

Market Research Findings
e #1 consumer desire is that the control
have a “fancy look and feel” not a
functional look.
e #2 priority of consumers is that the device
be technologically innovative
e 3'¢ priority was for ease of use.
Real Reaction

Top Style Trends
e Top European fashion trend is for styles
that reflect a fruit and vegetable theme
especially in clothes and furniture
e Material trends are quickly shifting from
hard materials to soft, spongy textures
Real Reaction

Style Trend Overview
e Style is paramount
e Innovative design and technology also a must
e Ease of use must be ensured throughout
e Vibrant natural colour
e Softness in materials, shape and function
—Think mac iPod

type design — not attractive nor
comfortable
e Most controls are dark colours — easily lost

Personal Preferences
e Standard colour coding eg red button for
standby
e Large, easy to use and identify buttons —
but not huge
e Intuitive markings on buttons eg volume
up shouldn’t be “V”
e Easily visible colour (if possible with
corporate colour scheme)
Real Reaction

e Extra features will be hidden by hinged
Opening mechanism — something like a tin
pencil case
e Voice activated options should always
have a button based alternative
e Ergonomic & attractive shape overall —
“Big Square Block” is ugly
e Voice control confirms action by talking
back
